title: Format SPEC v0 + reference model (pure, Node)
goal: A pure, deterministic, DOM-free core that defines state, primitive ops, the ledger event format, canonical JSON, SHA-256 and the reducer, plus a SPEC.md complete enough for an independent implementation.
scope: src/canon.js: canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace, integers only, "<" → \u003c, U+2028/2029 escaped, lone surrogates rejected)

src/model.js: state {doc, blocks:[{id,type:p|h1|h2|h3|li,text,marks}], heads, clock}; ops blk, split, join, ins, del, fmt, type; validate(op,state) with error codes; apply(state,op) pure; inverse(op,stateBefore)

src/ledger.js (core): JSONL with header, expansion of implicit p/c/a, id computation, heads verification, topological replay with deterministic tiebreak (lamport, actor), append(event) → line, serialize
Ids: actor 6–8 chars base62 per session (crypto.getRandomValues), doc id 128-bit base62, block id <actor>:<n>, block order via after
docs/SPEC.md v0: grammar, op semantics with examples, canonical JSON, hashing, implicit-field expansion, integrity, versioning (fmt webdoc/0), forward compatibility (unknown op → read-only)
Property tests (node --test, seeded) and NIST SHA-256 vectors
Fixture ledgers: empty, EN, DE, stress, 10k words (word-level events), multi-parent DAG
out_of_scope: Merge UI (Phase 6) — but the format must accept multiple parents

rules.rule: Event sourcing: the current state is the replay of the ledger top to bottom.
id = sha256(canonical(expanded event without id)); DAG-capable (≥ 2 parents parse and verify).
Offsets in UTF-16 code units; an op never splits a surrogate pair.
No Date.now() or Math.random() in the reducer; time and randomness only at event creation.
Blank documents have an empty ledger; the genesis with a fresh doc id is created on first edit.

bar.primary: Metric: property tests, NIST vectors and an independent reader built from SPEC.md alone
secondary: Independent reader: a separate fresh agent without access to src/ implements a reader from SPEC.md in a temp dir; its state hashes for the fixture ledgers must match
metrics: replay of 20k events ≤ 100 ms in Node
JSONL bytes of the 10k-word fixture recorded

criteria: NIST vectors pass; sha256 equals node:crypto on 10 000 random inputs including non-BMP characters.
Canonical JSON: for 10 000 random objects canon(parse(canon(x))) === canon(x); output never contains "</script" or "<!--"; U+2028/2029 escaped.
10 000 seeded random op sequences: replay deterministic (equal hash twice), applying inverse restores the state hash, serialize → parse identical.
Tamper test: flipping one character at 200 random positions of a ledger always makes verify() report an integrity error.
The same ledger stored fully explicit and stored lean yields identical ids.
A multi-parent fixture parses, verifies and replays in deterministic topological order.
The validator rejects offset > length, a surrogate-splitting op, an unknown block id and joining the first block; an unknown op sets read-only instead of throwing.
SPEC.md complete; the independent reader reproduces the state hashes of all 5 fixture ledgers.
Size of the 10k-word fixture recorded in docs/plan/size-log.md.
acceptance.critic: Criteria-based. The independent-reader result is mandatory evidence; the gap is the first unproven criterion.

decision_note: Phase 1 never creates multiple parents, but parses and verifies them so Phase 6 needs no format break.
